description: This file defines the `Unique` class within the PhpSpreadsheet library, implementing the UNIQUE function to extract unique values from ranges or arrays, supporting options like by column and exactly once filtering.

classes.name: Unique
classes.description: Provides methods to compute unique values from input data, with options to consider data by row or by column and to filter for values that occur exactly once.

methods.name: unique
methods.description: Public static method that returns unique values from a range or array, with options for column-based lookup and filtering for exactly once occurrence.

methods.name: uniqueByRow
methods.description: Private method to determine unique entries in a row-based context, handling array implosion and restoration.

methods.name: uniqueByColumn
methods.description: Private method to determine unique entries when considering columns, transposing data if needed, and counting values case-insensitively.

methods.name: countValuesCaseInsensitive
methods.description: Counts occurrences of values in an array, treating them case-insensitively, and distinguishing numeric and string keys.

methods.name: exactlyOnceFilter
methods.description: Filters an array to include only values that occur exactly once.
